Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in its final analysis by confusing "different federal subjects" with "different countries." The WebSurfer correctly identified that both Tomskoye (Amur Oblast) and Pleshkovo (Altai Krai) are located in Russia. The Planner incorrectly concluded that because the two locations are in different administrative regions (Amur Oblast vs. Altai Krai), they are not in the same country. This is a fundamental geographical misunderstanding: different regions within a single nation do not imply different countries. The error stems from a failure to synthesize the fact that both regions belong to the same sovereign state (Russia) and incorrectly treating regional boundaries as national boundaries.
